comment: Hand-maintained coverage claims for the BuildRight portfolio against the erpplans requirement catalog. Prefix entries set the DEFAULT state for every requirement with that ID prefix; 'requirements' entries override individual rows with specific evidence. Statuses: covered = implemented and suite-pinned; partial = implemented subset, named gaps; uncovered = no app metadata yet. Waves follow apps/buildright/README.md. Every 'partial'/'covered' claim must name its evidence (app + artifact surface) — claims without evidence fail review.

FIN.note: GL/AR core is the Phase 7 corpus (journals, AR documents, period close, aging); AP joins via the wave-1 P2P app; assets/tax/intercompany/treasury remain wave 2+ (Erp gap log G-9, G-13 track AP-bill and revaluation).

INV.note: Receipt-side ledger with conditional roll-ups and weighted-average costing is proven (inventoryCosting suite); transfers/counts/lots/serials are wave 2 (Erp gap log FIFO/lot entry).

PUR.note: Wave 1 ships the PO→receipt→bill→payment document chain with threshold approval; replenishment/imports/RTV/scorecards are wave 2+; hard 3-way-match guards are logged (BR-G-2).

MDM.note: Minimal Item/Vendor master entities exist for the P2P cycle; the 55K-SKU controlled item-master workflow is wave 3.

CCR.note: AR aging, dunning letters, and credit limits exist in the Phase 7 corpus; scoring/alert automation is wave 3.

POS.note: Best-of-breed edge per the sourcing doctrine — integration metadata (webhooks/imports), never entities.

SCP.note: Replenishment planning rides PUR wave 3; full SCP is a bought edge.

HR.note: HCM is a bought edge (hire-to-retire); only expense/integration seams land here.

CRM.note: Loyalty/CRM rides the edge stack; portfolio models the integration seam.

GOV.note: Governance workflows are process-layer (BPMN + task inboxes) once wave-2 domains land.

RPT.note: The reporting pillar exists platform-side; the specific RPT-00x executive/tax reports are wave 2 app metadata.

COM.note: Intercompany (R11) is wave 2; general communications wave 3.

MER.note: Merchandising strategy is a planning discipline — wave 4.

DOC.note: Document management rides the File service + retention platform work (BIR 10-year forcing function).

VPP.note: Vendor portal — inbound webhook/import seam, wave 3.

BIA.note: BI operations ride the platform reporting/analytics stack; wave 4 for app metadata.

RCL.note: Recall management needs lot tracking (wave 2 inventory) first.

IC.note: Intercompany & transfer pricing — wave 2 R2R depth.

LOG.note: Transport management is a bought edge (TMS).

PRJ.note: Project/trade coordination — the in-house differentiator archetype; wave 4.

NFR.note: Non-functionals are platform contracts (PLAN.md §1, IMPLEMENTATION.md), not app metadata — tracked by the platform phases and the perf harness (apps/perf), not per-requirement here.

PUR-001.evidence: PurchaseOrder entity + DRAFT→SUBMITTED→APPROVED→CLOSED machine; close process itself unsuite-pinned (wave 2)

PUR-003.evidence: Vendor master (terms, contact); performance scorecards absent (wave 2+)

PUR-005.evidence: PO/GoodsReceipt/VendorBill chain with poLine + item references; hard quantity guards are BR-G-2, approval gate is the compensating control (p2pReceivingBillingEdges)

PUR-010.evidence: Threshold approval (approvalThreshold, mode-all, the requester's task-access denial pinned in p2pApprovalEdges); single approval level — multi-level escalation is a platform deferral (PLAN §1)

PUR-011.evidence: GoodsReceipt with costing on post, terminal freeze (p2pHappyPath, p2pReceivingBillingEdges); DSD store-level receipt is the same entity (location dimension wave 2)

FIN-004.evidence: VendorBill auto-journal with approval (submitForPosting flow, JE balanced + frozen); matching guards = BR-G-2 (same claim as PUR-005)

FIN-014.evidence: Document-currency FX with book-currency posting (fxRate + totalBook, creditAndCurrency suite); revaluation/realized gain-loss = Erp G-9

FIN-015.evidence: AccountingPeriod machine + periodLock harvest + closeChecklist BPMN (controls suite)

INV-003.evidence: Weighted-average costing via the declarative bind flow; inventoryCosting suite pins the numbers

INV-015.evidence: inventoryValuation report (value/qty totals); by-location/category slicing waits for report join-lowering (Erp G-12)

MDM-001.evidence: Item master entity (SKU-unique); controlled creation workflow is wave 3
